docs.purpose: The one-question page before the report (SEMI-B; operator "semi ask a", 2026-11-13). When the detector is unsure whether a lot is half of a semi (the doubt band of Spec 78 O-4: a footprint over 3 parcels, or a weak or small shared boundary), the app asks one question before the report shows: "Is this house one half of a semi-detached pair?" with three answers: "Yes, it's one half of a semi" (semi view, renovations only), "No, it's detached" (the full report), "Not sure" (the semi view, with "This isn't a semi" still offered in the report). Clear semis and clear detached lots never see this page. Nothing is selected when the page opens; Continue is disabled until an answer is chosen.
docs.data_story: It reads one contract, GET /api/parcels/lookup?parcelId= (C-001), through the same query the report reads (['parcel-lookup', parcelId]), so it makes no extra request. The server names the lot's form from the view parcel_lot_form (migration 320): lotForm.detected, lotForm.basis and lotForm.unsure; the page asks only when unsure is true. The answer is the owner's input lot_form_user_override (Spec 78): yes writes semi_half, no writes detached, not sure writes nothing. It is carried to the report as a route param and applied there through the shared pure function lotFormEffective (O-12: the pipeline never reads it; there is no server store). It emits **no analytics event**.
docs.under_126: **CONVERTED (SEMI-B)** — LIST (three radio cards and a Continue button), rendered by the shared mobile binding (SemiQuestionBinding.tsx props, SurfaceRenderer.tsx parts) from this descriptor and its content file, on the MF-53 pattern. It owns no component.

identity.owner: unassigned (no CODEOWNERS file and no owner registry exists in the repo — measured 2026-09-16)

versioning.why: It reads `lotForm` as sent; the block is optional in the mobile mirror, so a payload from an older server still parses and the page never asks.

inputs.why: One GET /api/parcels/lookup?parcelId= through useParcelLookup, the same TanStack entry the report reads. The route param `parcelId` is the lot; whether to ask comes from the response (`lotForm.unsure`), never from the param.

outputs.why: It writes nothing to a server: the answer is the owner's input lot_form_user_override, carried to the report as the route param lotFormOverride (yes semi_half, no detached, not sure none) with semi=answered, and applied there by lotFormEffective (O-12: the pipeline never reads it). The only action is opening the report.

state.why: No store: the chosen answer is component useState in the mount (nothing selected at open), cleared when the page leaves.

staleness.why: useParcelLookup declares a 60-second staleTime; the page reuses the report entry.

session.why: It inherits the tab gate and the parcel-tool Stack: shell_app_tabs will not mount the tab tree at all unless subscription_status is trial/active/past_due/admin_managed.

rls_class.why: parcels, address_points and parcel_address_points are RLS-enabled with zero policies (default deny), read as the table owner through C-001.

guards.rate_bucket: parcels-lookup:{uid} — 30/min, 60s window (the detail bucket; the page shares the report request)

list.item_archetype: answer card (the answer text, a check when chosen)

checks.why: operator "semi ask a" 2026-11-13: the question is asked ONLY when the detector is unsure (lotForm.unsure); a clear semi, a clear detached lot and an older server (no block) go straight to the report. Locked by mobile/__tests__/lotForm.test.ts and semiQuestionPage.behaviour.test.tsx.

The MF-53 rule (parceldisambig_nothing_preselected) applied to this page: no answer is selected when it opens and Continue is disabled until a tap; an answer is the owner's choice, never a default. Locked by mobile/__tests__/semiQuestionScreens.golden.test.ts.

errors.why: Every failure class has its own notice (the search page's classes and copy); the schema drift text has no Retry.

classes.ui: A distinct locked-out line: the parcel tool is not in the current subscription. Explicitly says this is not a missing address.
Inline red "Too many searches. Try again in Ns." from RateLimitError.retryAfterSeconds.
Inline red "Couldn’t reach the lot service." with a Try-again button wired to refetch().
Inline red "We couldn’t read the response for that address" and NO retry button — a deterministic failure is not worth a second round trip. Sentry already has it.

emits.why: No client analytics in SEMI-B; the only record of a lookup is the server log line, which carries the form and the unsure flag, never the address.

metering.why: The question shows no report and counts nothing; the report it opens meters through the parcelId path as before.

config.why: The detector's cuts are admin-editable logic variables read by the view parcel_lot_form (migration 320); the page itself has no tunable and reads only the unsure flag.

sharing.why: It shares C-001 and its report query with the report (S-001).

deviations.from: Spec 126 §11a.1 closed binding set (content, contract, ...): the three answers are an ordered client list
deviations.why: P35-D14 a form: the answers are the closed list yes, no, not_sure from mobile/src/lib/lotForm.ts SEMI_ANSWERS (derived names answer.<i>), and the renderer's `select` action carries the answer id instead of a parcel id (the one mount callback maps it; SurfaceRenderer.tsx is not changed).
deviations.adjudicated_by: operator 2026-11-13, "semi ask a - and we need a new mini page similar to the \"choose your lot\" excpet it just asks one question" (reuse of the MF-53 components and pattern)

deviations.from: Spec 126 R-01 / Spec 116 §5 OD5 amendment: a parcel_tool surface is gated on the parcel_tool entitlement
deviations.why: Reached through the transitional lead_gen path like the search page (the lookup route admits the lead_gen status; the App A shelf passes the Buildo app gate). Removed by MF-50 (and the app gate by MF-49).
deviations.adjudicated_by: operator 2026-11-11, MF-45 D-4 (a) ("all five a"); queue row MF-45

limitations.what: The answer is not stored on a server: it is a route param read by the report, so a lot opened again later (a new session, a deep link) asks again when it is still unsure. A stored answer is owed with the report's owner-input path (APP-RENO).
limitations.measured: mobile/src/lib/lotForm.ts reportRouteAfterAnswer; no table holds lot_form_user_override (grep of migrations, 2026-11-13).

limitations.what: The report page applies the override through lotFormEffective only when the report's semi rules are mounted (renovation cards, increment 6); today the param is carried and the report still shows its approved miss text.

notes: SEMI-B (operator "semi all y" and "semi ask a", 2026-11-13). The mini page of the address-lookup flow, modelled on S-071 (MF-53). The report mount [parcelId].tsx replaces itself with this page once, on the first settled data, when lotForm.unsure is true and the route has no `semi` param; Continue replaces this page with the report carrying semi=answered (and lotFormOverride for yes and no). Archetype LIST: radio cards and one Continue, like the lot cards.

programme.why: The question before the report for a lot the detector cannot place: one question on the entry flow of the parcel tool.
